bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to environment; appropriating money to improve water quality in Upper Twin Lake.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; IMPROVE WATER QUALITY IN UPPER TWIN LAKE. +]

[+(a) $....... in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of the Pollution Control Agency for a grant to the Twin Lake Association for a two-year water-quality improvement project at Upper Twin Lake in Hennepin County. The grant must be used to contract for new and innovative nonchemical, flow-through, water-quality improvement technologies and testing services; necessary infrastructure; selective invasive weed control; carp control; training; and maintenance. This appropriation is available until June 30, 2028. +]

[+(b) $....... in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of natural resources for a grant to Twin Lake Association to address increased weed-harvesting needs at Upper Twin Lake in Hennepin County. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to environment; appropriating money to improve water quality in Upper Twin Lake.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; IMPROVE WATER QUALITY IN UPPER TWIN LAKE.

(a) $....... in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of the Pollution Control Agency for a grant to the Twin Lake Association for a two-year water-quality improvement project at Upper Twin Lake in Hennepin County. The grant must be used to contract for new and innovative nonchemical, flow-through, water-quality improvement technologies and testing services; necessary infrastructure; selective invasive weed control; carp control; training; and maintenance. This appropriation is available until June 30, 2028.

(b) $....... in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of natural resources for a grant to Twin Lake Association to address increased weed-harvesting needs at Upper Twin Lake in Hennepin County.

This appropriation is available until June 30, 2028.

(b) $....... in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of natural resources for a grant to Twin Lake Association to address increased weed-harvesting needs at Upper Twin Lake in Hennepin County.
